The chart contains fourteen bars, representing the years from 2008 to 2021 inclusive, not thirteen.

errors.evidence: While the bar for 2014 has the value 13,782, the bars for 2013 and 2015 have visibly different heights. The bar for 2013 is lower (around 13,500), and the bar for 2015 is higher (around 14,100). It is inaccurate to state they all have a similar height of approximately 13,782.
